gaps.what: No page dates or bounds a Ripuarian state before 459: start 238 and the shapes to 458 are Cliopatria's; found (238) and the gains of 260, 367, 439, 462 (Eifel strip) and 469 stay confidence 1. The reviewer's six thin-check pages (Chamavi, Postumus, Great Conspiracy, Flavius Aetius, Aegidius, Thuringii) were opened and are silent on all six strips; Aegidius dates the Ripuarian fall of Cologne and Trier 'about 457' (citation needed) against 459 (Trier) and 462 (History of Cologne)

Cologne (462) sits in Cliopatria's Kingdom of the Franks row and Trier in its Kingdom of Alamannia row, not in the Ripuarian shape; the 462, 469 and 500 corrections and the 509 dissolve now add both to the Ripuarian realm; the overlap with kingdom-of-the-franks, kingdom-of-alamannia and, for Trier in 500-509, the Salian realm needs a Phase C decision
